# Buy WBTC

> Buy WBTC is a non-custodial interface for swapping ETH, USDC, USDT or other ERC-20 tokens for WBTC (Wrapped Bitcoin) on Ethereum through DEX routing. Users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction. There are no card or fiat purchases.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- WBTC is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum backed 1:1 by BTC held by a custodian.
- Users sell ETH, USDC, USDT or other ERC-20 tokens and receive WBTC in their own wallet.
- Crypto in an Ethereum wallet is required first; card and fiat purchases are not supported.
- Gas is paid in ETH, and ERC-20 sell tokens need a one-time approval before the swap.
- The interface is non-custodial: it quotes and routes but never holds funds or keys.
